_meta.notes: 'Financial Disclosure Report For an Open Campaign Account' form. Entire filing handwritten in red ink. BOTH the Year-End (Period ending December 31) and the Final/Dissolution boxes are checked. NEITHER amendment box (Yes/No) is checked — is_amendment left blank, not assumed. Signature date handwritten 2/16/26; clerk Date Received stamp FEB 20 2026. Cover name/office/party handwritten: 'Aaron Wiley' / 'SL county District 1' (Office cell, verbatim) / 'Democrat'; this form has no separate Office Sought row. Cover address and signature blocks blacked at source. Every Summary Page (p2) cell carries a handwritten slashed-zero glyph (Ø) — transcribed as 0 per the zero-glyph ruling. Page order is unusual: cover / Summary / Summary Page Other Campaign Accounts / Itemized Contributions from Other Campaign Accounts (blank grid) / Schedule A (blank grid) / Schedule B (blank grid) / Itemized Expenditures from Other Campaign Accounts (blank grid) / wholly blank p8. The Other Campaign Accounts summary (p3) is handwritten: line 1 Column A '0' with Column B Year-to-Date '25.20'; line 2 Column A '0', Column B blank; lines 3/5/7 '25.20', lines 4/6 '0' — a $25.20 balance carried in a non-county account, with NO itemized lines filed for it (p4 and p7 grids blank); recorded here, not transcribed as county Schedule A/B activity.

contributions.detail: Schedule A grid (p5) present and wholly blank, its SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells left blank; zero rows = handwritten zero on Summary line 1

expenditures.detail: Schedule B grid (p6) present and wholly blank, its SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells left blank; zero rows = handwritten zero on Summary line 2
